simple.summary: צָעַר (tsâʻar) means to be small , i.e. (figuratively) ignoble First listed occurrence: Jer 30 19.

definitions.usage: be brought low, little one, be small.
definitions.full: H6819. tsaar [ צָעַר ] verb be, or grow, insignificant (|| זער ; Late Hebrew id. , Assyrian ƒe—êru , be small , Arabic id. ; Syriac be insignificant, despicable ; צְעַר ᵑ7 transitive despise, revile ; — Qal Imperfect (opposed to כָּבֵד ), 3 masculine plural יִצְעֲרוּ Job 14:21 , יִצְעָ֑רוּ Jer 30:19 ; Participle as substantive הַצֹּעֲרִים Zech 13:7 (i.e. sheep, in figure, compare Now).
